description: Return the ordered activity timeline for one report (oldest to newest), merging reporter comments, fix events, QA runs, skill-pipeline steps, and Ask Mushi turns into one lane. Returns { events: [{ ts, kind, actor, summary }] }. Read-only. Use to see what happened end-to-end on a report thread; use get_report_detail for the static record or get_fix_timeline to debug one fix attempt.

reportId.description: The report UUID (`report_id` is accepted too.)

name: get_report_timeline
title: Unified report timeline
